Method of Attack: Spam botnet abusing social media sharing widgets with 'email-link-to-a-friend' feature to send spam messages containing gambling app links and random text snippets from novels to mask spam detection
Sending over 1 million HTTP requests from infected bots mostly with Chinese IP addresses targeting social widgets on 60 domains
Impacted Systems: Social sharing widgets hosted on 60 domains
Attack Vector: Abuse of social media sharing widgets' email-link-to-a-friend feature
Botnet sending requests from infected bots
Indicators of Compromise: Links to gambling app websites included in spam messages
Random text snippets from 'Star Wars - Darth Bane - Path to Destruction' by Drew Karpyshyn, 'Jane Eyre' by Charlotte Brontë, and works by Edgar Allan Poe
